title: ChargePoint Home Flex uploadsm filetype Link Following Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability. (CVE-2026-131815)
description: CVE-2026-131815 is a local privilege escalation vulnerability in ChargePoint Home Flex EV chargers. It arises from improper handling of the filetype parameter in the uploadsm endpoint, allowing an attacker with low-privileged code execution to create symbolic links and write arbitrary files. Exploiting this flaw can lead to root-level code execution.
